cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our garden door opens into the broom cupboard. Wonderful, we can take a brush for the picnic crumbs. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the attic. I'm carrying all the sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Perfect. Grab the picnic blanket without climbing stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the cellar. The sandwiches are getting warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Built-in refrigeration. Put them beside the wine; this door is catering.

mechanism: A directs picnic preparation and takes the carrying burden while interpreting each wrong door destination as a useful built-in service.
confusable: Unlike changing to a secret new mission, A keeps preparing the picnic and finds benefits in each portal failure.
comparison: A shifting door supplying picnic needs differs from a backward clock eliminating a meeting.
seedUse: D164-a broom cupboard, attic, cellar and warm sandwiches; S02-a shares work after B load concern.
